about: The open FOCUS_Spec issues and pull requests that concern each dataset and column, matched by the files they change and the names in their titles and descriptions, rebuilt daily from GitHub. Each thread's summary is written by an AI model from the thread, or reused from the History or Recent summaries, and rewritten when the thread gains comments or reviews. The summaries paraphrase those discussions and name participants by their GitHub usernames.

959.title: [FR] Add service-model classification
959.author: Matt-Cowsert
959.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 1 May 2025 for a ServiceModel column grouping cloud spend as IaaS, PaaS and SaaS across providers. Proposed values also included FaaS, CaaS and on-prem. A maintainer assessment proposed a minimal version with IaaS, PaaS and SaaS plus a non-normative mapping appendix. On 2 May 2025 Matt-Cowsert added support from Under Armour and SailPoint. The thread does not record an outcome; the issue remains open.

960.title: [FR] Enable preview status for content smaller than a dataset
960.author: Matt-Cowsert
960.summary: Matt-Cowsert proposed letting a single new column, attribute, column value or requirement on a stable dataset carry preview status, so practitioners could test it without it going stable. ljadvey questioned the benefit beyond existing x_ columns, and shawnalpay raised open questions. By 3 November 2026 it was scoped to the proposed 1.6 Core scope, after #2782 and #2811. The thread doesn't record the outcome.

963.title: [FR] Add SKU categorizations / hierarchy
963.author: Matt-Cowsert
963.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 1 May 2025 for normalized SKU categories and subcategories, because SkuId and SkuPriceId are opaque and need external lookups. Workday, MagicOrange and Tyler Technologies were added as supporting organizations in May 2025. On 27 May 2025, shawnalpay asked for the use cases to be revised. The thread doesn't record an outcome; the issue remains open.

964.title: [FR] Define metric column design principles
964.author: Matt-Cowsert
964.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 1 May 2025 for a documented principle on whether new metric columns should be derivatives (finalized values such as BilledCost) or primitives (building blocks). It reports that the TF-1 group, while designing v1.1, concluded to build derivatives first. On 27 May 2025, shawnalpay replied that the request needs a use case. The thread records no further discussion or outcome, and the issue remains open.

970.title: [FR] Add granularity levels between billing account and sub account
970.author: Matt-Cowsert
970.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request in May 2025 for normalized FOCUS columns covering account levels between billing account and sub account, such as GCP folders. Resource groups were split out to #1496. Ten organizations backed it, and richwang99 and mike-finopsorg stressed its importance. In October 2025 Matt-Cowsert noted AWS resource groups are absent from the Cost and Usage Report. The thread doesn't record an outcome; it remains open.

972.title: [FR] Add granular sustainability dimensions and metrics
972.author: Matt-Cowsert
972.summary: Issue #972, opened by Matt-Cowsert in May 2025, asks FOCUS to add optional carbon, power and water columns beside cost and usage, at resource and region level. Two recent comments have no maintainer reply yet. guillermollopis narrows the idea to AI token rows, proposing estimated kWh and location-based kg CO2e plus a provenance field stating method and grid basis, so modelled values are labelled as estimates. seanmcilroy29, for the Green Software Foundation, asks FOCUS to reuse its SCI, SWI and SEI definitions through an ISO reference rather than define its own, and suggests a supplemental dataset as an option to optional columns. Both are constructive and offer collaboration. Open questions on placement, default basis and energy unit have no answers yet, so the thread seems early and waiting on working group direction.

973.title: [FR] Provide guidance for custom, practitioner-defined cost allocation
973.author: Matt-Cowsert
973.summary: In May 2025, Matt-Cowsert requested guidance on custom, practitioner-defined cost allocation, citing Goldman Sachs and Northwestern Mutual. The proposed supporting content would show how FOCUS columns such as Tags, SubAccountId and ResourceId join to external data like Prometheus metrics or spreadsheet split percentages. The body framed it as non-normative documentation. The thread doesn't record an outcome, and the issue remained open.

974.title: [FR] Add ability to prevent double-counting of costs and quantities
974.author: Matt-Cowsert
974.summary: On 2 May 2025 Matt-Cowsert asked to prevent double-counting of commitment purchases and amortized rows when comparing ListCost or ContractedCost with EffectiveCost, proposing an AmortizationCategory column. On 13 May 2025 shawnalpay returned it to Needs More Info, noting related work in #647 and #747 was postponed and #1009 on amortization was a prerequisite. On 19 May 2025 kk09v suggested covering unit double-counting. No outcome is recorded; it remains open.

975.title: [FR] Add recommendations dataset for optimization activities
975.author: Matt-Cowsert
975.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this feature request for a normalized recommendations dataset, because practitioners receive optimization recommendations such as rightsizing and commitment purchases from many providers in different formats; eleven organizations backed it. In 2026 the work moved to task force 2 through #2444, and the thread recorded decisions there: evaluation period start and end columns with duration deferred, past-participle date column names, and RecommendationProviderName in place of DataGeneratorName. flanakin and rileyjenk disagreed over resource configuration columns, and the scope was trimmed before initial Member review in September 2026. In October 2026 maintainers moved the dataset and its supported feature, #2583, to the 1.6 cycle for lack of consensus on its shape and names. The request remained open.

977.title: [FR] Clarify treatment of bring-your-own-license (BYOL) cost reductions
977.author: Matt-Cowsert
977.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 2 May 2025, asking FOCUS to standardize how bring-your-own-license discounts are identified and measured. shawnalpay moved it to Needs More Info on 13 May 2025 pending a use case. Matt-Cowsert then noted on 15 May that it may overlap with #1045, and on 22 May agreed to draft use cases with beau-nelford-anglepoint. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

984.title: [FR] Add mapping of provider service names to Service Category and Subcategory
984.author: Matt-Cowsert
984.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested in May 2025 a community-maintained registry mapping provider service names to FOCUS ServiceCategory and ServiceSubcategory. Six organizations, including AWS, supported it. shawnalpay pointed to Azure's open data in the FinOps Toolkit and suggested adding ServiceId field. In March 2026, Matt-Cowsert cited EBS costs landing in Compute. shawnalpay warned that a community list could conflict with providers' own labels. The thread doesn't record an outcome; it remains open.

1006.title: [Process] Adding new datasets to FOCUS beyond the first one
1006.author: shawnalpay
1006.summary: Opened by shawnalpay on 9 May 2025, #1006 asks whether and when FOCUS should add datasets beyond its single cost and usage table, citing backlog requests like Region and Invoice. It warns that new tables could mean moving dimension columns out of the main table, possibly toward a "FOCUS 2.0" star schema. shawnalpay argued for conceptual analysis before table-level work. The thread is still open and records no decision.

1008.title: [FR] Clarify Service and Resource columns for non-service charges
1008.author: Matt-Cowsert
1008.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1008 on 9 May 2025, asking how service and resource columns should be populated for non-service charges, such as virtual currency. On 13 May 2025, shawnalpay proposed either allowing nulls under a condition or keeping the not-null rule with guidance. On 19 May 2025, shawnalpay returned the issue to Needs More Info because the use case section lacked a use case. The issue remains open with no decision.

1013.title: [FR] Add invoice-level correction handling rules
1013.author: ljadvey
1013.summary: ljadvey opened this request in May 2025 asking FOCUS to define how invoice corrections appear, either as overwritten original rows or as additive variance rows referencing the original invoice. Matt-Cowsert asked for organizational support. In September 2026, Matt-Cowsert proposed closing it, noting FOCUS 1.4 covers invoice-level corrections but has no charge-level link, and asked ljadvey to reply by 5 October 2026. The thread doesn't record the outcome.

1014.title: [FR] Add workload-timezone and location dimensions (e.g., timezone, country, state, city)
1014.author: Matt-Cowsert
1014.summary: In May 2025 Matt-Cowsert requested country, state, city and timezone dimensions for geographic reporting and carbon analysis. shawnalpay noted overlap with #88 and suggested considering region attributes together, possibly in a lookup table. robmartin33 raised custom location codes and AWS's Location column, asking which fields are needed. Matt-Cowsert planned to add organizational support, and shawnalpay found effort hard to estimate. The thread is still open with no recorded outcome.

1021.title: [FR] Clarify InvoiceId-to-BillingAccount relationship
1021.author: Matt-Cowsert
1021.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1021 on 12 May 2025 seeking a normative requirement that each InvoiceId maps to one BillingAccountId, citing AWS and Microsoft. On 13 May Matt-Cowsert asked ijurica to add organization support. On 19 May shawnalpay wanted provider examples showing where the rule conflicts with real invoices, set the issue to Needs More Info, and asked ijurica to supply one. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue remains open.

1027.title: [FR] Rename "Charge" row term to just "Row"
1027.author: rileyjenk
1027.summary: rileyjenk proposed in May 2025 replacing "charge" with "row" since its double meaning confuses readers. Matt-Cowsert asked for organizational support. shawnalpay asked whether column names like ChargeCategory would change. rileyjenk replied that users read those names through their own sense of charge. In November 2026, kk09v noted the SKU Price dataset uses "record" for the same concept and that both terms can be verbs. The thread records no outcome.

1028.title: [FR] Enable localization of column names and normalized values
1028.author: Matt-Cowsert
1028.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1028 on 12 May 2025 asking how FOCUS should handle localized column names and normalized values, suggesting UTF-8 and separating canonical identifiers from display names. Matt-Cowsert then said it needs organizational support before prioritization. On 19 May 2025 shawnalpay found the ask, use case and approach unclear and raised questions about provider support. The issue remains open, and the thread records no decision.

1029.title: [FR] Add a FOCUS compliant forecast dataset
1029.author: Matt-Cowsert
1029.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 12 May 2025 for a FOCUS-compliant forecast dataset to normalize predicted costs alongside actuals. Workday and Aer Lingus requested it, the latter citing #650. The maintainer assessment suggested an optional actual-or-forecast column. On 19 May 2025, shawnalpay said more information was needed, especially which datapoints to include, and returned the issue to Needs More Info. It remains open.

1033.title: [FR] Clarify spec language to remove jargon terms
1033.author: Matt-Cowsert
1033.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 13 May 2025 to replace finance jargon such as accrual-basis and cash-basis with plain language or glossary links. Neos, Microsoft and StitcherAI requested it. shawnalpay asked for a specific term list to estimate the work, and rileyjenk asked what counts as jargon. Matt-Cowsert later suggested defining drafting principles. The thread doesn't record the outcome, and the issue remains open.

1034.title: [FR] Clarify ChargeDescription column definition
1034.author: Matt-Cowsert
1034.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1034 on 13 May 2025, asking for normative rules on what ChargeDescription should contain, since providers vary widely and verbose descriptions risk data bloat. On 19 May 2025 shawnalpay asked for a use case and examples, arguing that the column should stay a free-form catch-all with other columns adding structure. The thread doesn't record the outcome, and the issue was still open.

1039.title: [FR] Define default behavior for null name columns
1039.author: Matt-Cowsert
1039.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 14 May 2025, proposing that Name columns such as BillingAccountName fall back to the corresponding ID when no display name exists, sparing practitioners fallback logic. Concerns raised were data duplication and false matches in name-based filters. In April 2026 Matt-Cowsert noted feedback that this transformation may belong with data generators or practitioners, referencing #105. The issue remains open with no recorded decision.

1040.title: [FR] Add canonical mapping of provider-native values to FOCUS dimensions
1040.author: Matt-Cowsert
1040.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 14 May 2025 for a community-maintained artifact mapping provider-native billing values to FOCUS dimensions, so practitioners and vendors avoid building their own. shawnalpay questioned the use case, asked for public sources and a maintenance commitment, and suggested folding #980 into this issue. Matt-Cowsert later added support from Calligo, TruPositive AI and Caterpillar in June 2025. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1042.title: [FR] Provide EffectiveSavingsRate examples
1042.author: Matt-Cowsert
1042.summary: In May 2025 Matt-Cowsert asked for examples of calculating Effective Savings Rate from FOCUS cost columns, offering two formula variants. On 15 May shawnalpay welcomed linking FinOps KPIs to FOCUS but noted the two ESR variants make a single definition hard. On 19 May shawnalpay asked what work was actually needed and set the issue to Needs More Info. The thread doesn't record a resolution, so it remains open.

1043.title: [FR] Add mutability indicator to column normative requirements
1043.author: Matt-Cowsert
1043.summary: Matt-Cowsert proposed adding a "mutable" constraint, true or false, to each column's content constraints, so FOCUS data processors know which columns, like BillingAccountId versus BillingAccountName, are safe as canonical keys. ljadvey supported it, suggesting most columns should be immutable except Tags. kk09v liked it but wanted "immutable" defined with regard to what, not just true/false. The issue remains open; no decision is recorded.

1044.title: [FR] Clarify meaning and usage of "amortization" in FOCUS
1044.author: ijurica
1044.summary: Issue #1044, opened by ijurica on 14 May 2025, asked the spec to clarify "amortization", which it argued describes usage-based cost spreading rather than the classical scheduled spread. Proposed options were aligning with the classical meaning, clarifying the term, or renaming it. On 19 May 2025, shawnalpay asked for one or more use cases. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue was still open.

1045.title: [FR] Add SKU Properties Dataset
1045.author: ijurica
1045.summary: ijurica opened this request in May 2025, asking for SKU properties such as region, tiering and pricing terms to be available across providers, some as dedicated columns. shawnalpay asked for specific attributes, and sid-mengde listed top survey priorities. In July 2026 the discussion questioned keeping this separate from SKU Price, and rileyjenk argued SKU Price has limited value alone. No decision was reached, and the issue remains open.

1053.title: [FR] Clarify handling of tags in FOCUS
1053.author: Matt-Cowsert
1053.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 16 May 2025 to clarify which user-defined metadata belongs in the Tags column. Google noted that GCP labels, tags and network tags differ, so practitioners could not rely on Tags for all user-assigned metadata. On 19 May 2025 shawnalpay said the request needed significant revision and that its PDF-linked requirements must be embedded directly. The issue remains open.

1060.title: [FR] Establish FOCUS metadata-specification guidelines
1060.author: ijurica
1060.summary: In May 2025 ijurica proposed guidelines for writing FOCUS Metadata Specification elements, covering normative requirements, naming, glossary entries and a review of existing elements. shawnalpay cited the 1.2 work as precedent. Working-group sessions through late 2025 repeatedly deferred it. In November 2025 the group listed issues: inconsistent object structure, JSON-specific "array" terminology, datetime naming, and whether constraints apply to objects. A key question was whether FOCUS should mandate a JSON format, which rileyjenk called pivotal. In February 2026 shawnalpay returned the FR to In Development. On 9 February 2026 maintainers descoped the work from 1.4 to 1.5, pending an architectural decision in #1937, and put its action items on hold. The thread doesn't record a closure, so the issue remains open.

1063.title: [FR] Clarify SaaS granularity in provider marketplace exports
1063.author: Matt-Cowsert
1063.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request in May 2025, seeking minimum granularity standards for SaaS usage sold through cloud marketplaces, since aggregated exports block cost allocation and chargeback. shawnalpay asked where a practitioner quote came from and linked #1018. NASA, Suncorp, ST3Tailor and Collibra added support. In June 2025 the TF3 meeting reached no consensus, so work will focus on #982 first. The issue remains open.

1064.title: [FR] Define common billing tags for cost allocation
1064.author: Matt-Cowsert
1064.summary: Matt-Cowsert proposed in May 2025 a standard set of billing tag keys, such as environment, cost center and owner, to support chargeback without provider-specific JSON extraction. shawnalpay set it to Needs More Info, preferring a FinOps Foundation working group list and recommending the request cover only tag definitions, not new columns. ljadvey asked why it duplicates #973. Matt-Cowsert added ExxonMobil and Collibra support in June 2025. Still open.

1065.title: [FR] Improve integration of supporting content with FOCUS spec
1065.author: Matt-Cowsert
1065.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 20 May 2025 asking for supporting content such as examples and column mappings to be better integrated into the specification, stemming from #529. The proposal suggested a new mappings space, moving examples to the appendix, and a notes space for rationale. On 21 May 2025 shawnalpay said maintainers had discussed it on 12 May, wanted more community input, and suggested retitling it. It remains open.

1066.title: [FR] Separate dedicated/bare metal services into their own subcategory
1066.author: Matt-Cowsert
1066.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1066 in May 2025, asking to split dedicated and bare metal machines out of Virtual Machines for separate cost analysis. shawnalpay said the request needed cleanup and noted that AWS groups both under one service while OCI separates them, asking whether AWS bare metal should move to a new subcategory. kk09v linked research-credit material on 1 June 2025. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1069.title: [FR] Refine column normative requirements to cover edge cases
1069.author: ijurica
1069.summary: ijurica opened this request on 21 May 2025 to ask whether column normative requirements must cover every valid case, especially nullability. In May 2025 shawnalpay confirmed that the current wording allows a null CommitmentDiscountStatus for Tax charges and called the request hard to prioritize. On 27 September 2026 Matt-Cowsert proposed folding it into #1072. On 28 September 2026 ijurica agreed. The thread doesn't record a formal closure.

1071.title: [FR] Add unique row-identifier for FOCUS datasets
1071.author: Matt-Cowsert
1071.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested a unique row identifier for FOCUS datasets in May 2025, to support idempotent loading, deduplication and row-level allocation. shawnalpay noted that basic uniqueness is more achievable than an immutable identifier, a distinction maintainers ijurica and rileyjenk confirmed on 27 May 2025. SkyXOps, Electronic Arts and LaurentDumont added support. Matt-Cowsert moved the request out of version 1.3 scope in July 2025, keeping it in the backlog. It remains open.

1072.title: [FR] Clarify nullability conditions and column relationships
1072.author: ijurica
1072.summary: ijurica opened this on 21 May 2025 to clarify how conditional nullability and inter-column relationships should be written in normative requirements. shawnalpay supported the aim but worried it could delay Static Conformance Requirements work under #1054, which must proceed against stable 1.2. shawnalpay proposed revising editorial guidelines first, then applying specific guidelines, and asked whether the examples are complete. The thread doesn't record an outcome; still open.

1075.title: [FR] Expose resource(s) associated with the charged resource
1075.author: Matt-Cowsert
1075.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 21 May 2025 asking FOCUS to link child resources, such as a VM's disks, NICs and public IPs, to their parent, and snapshots to source disks. The aim was to total compound costs without provider-specific logic. SkyXOps and The Mastermind Group added community support in June 2025, and 5D Agility was added that month. The thread records no maintainer decision, so it was still open.

1083.title: [FR] Rename PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost column for clarity
1083.author: Matt-Cowsert
1083.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 21 May 2025 to rename PricingCurrencyEffectiveCost, a cost metric whose name leads with "Pricing" and may confuse practitioners. Google alone requests it, and alternatives such as EffectiveCostInPricingCurrency were suggested. On 28 May 2025 ijurica called formalizing column naming conventions a prerequisite, proposing either a separate feature request or adding it to #1068. The thread is still open and doesn't record a decision.

1084.title: [FR] Align top-percentile usage metric with interim cost columns
1084.author: Matt-Cowsert
1084.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 21 May 2025, asking FOCUS to represent top-percentile usage billing (for example, 95th percentile) and interim costs that recalculate daily until period close, so practitioners could forecast charges without vendor portals. Proposed attributes were UsagePercentile, PercentileUsageQuantity and InterimCost, phased with an InterimCost flag first. The maintainer assessment rated ambiguity at 4. The thread is open and records no outcome.

1085.title: [FR] Expose normalized consumed quantity beyond CSP commitment discounts
1085.author: Matt-Cowsert
1085.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested on 21 May 2025 two optional columns, NormalizationFactor per SKU and NormalizedConsumedQuantity per usage line, so practitioners could calculate commitment coverage and savings across instance families. Datadog, AWS and Azure requested it. On 22 May Matt-Cowsert split the request from #1017 into #1085 and #1084. sarahcloudpm asked on 28 May for "commitment discounts" to be defined. The thread records no decision and remains open.

1089.title: [FR] Clarify fully-qualified identifier (FQID) requirements and add glossary entries
1089.author: ijurica
1089.summary: ijurica opened this request on 22 May 2025 to clarify when CommitmentDiscountId, ResourceId, CapacityReservationId and BillingAccountId must hold fully qualified identifiers, and to add FQID and GUID glossary entries. It followed concerns raised in PR #787, and Twilio is listed as requesting it. On 27 May 2025, shawnalpay commented that the request needs a use case. The thread records no further outcome, and the issue remains open.

1092.title: [FR] Add output formats as a non-functional requirement
1092.author: Matt-Cowsert
1092.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request in May 2025, asking FOCUS to define standard output formats such as CSV and Parquet as a non-functional requirement so data engineers can avoid provider-specific logic. Suncorp, MGM and Cloudability were later added as supporting organizations. In October 2025, shawnalpay suggested adding implementation examples and consulting tooling vendors. The thread doesn't record a decision, and the issue remains open.

1093.title: [FR] Add data granularity as a non-functional requirement
1093.author: Matt-Cowsert
1093.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request in May 2025 for a non-functional requirement on data granularity, separating charge-period from billing-period detail so practitioners can run hourly or daily analyses. shawnalpay objected that forcing a minimum grain on all providers is problematic, and suggested documenting expected granularities and letting practitioners choose. Matt-Cowsert later added community support from a January 2026 call. The thread doesn't record a decision, and the issue remains open.

1095.title: [FR] Add refresh cadence as a non-functional requirement
1095.author: Matt-Cowsert
1095.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this on 23 May 2025, asking for a non-functional requirement on refresh cadence and data availability, requested by Salesforce and Twilio. The maintainers' assessment proposed documenting a cadence with a recommended daily minimum, leaving open whether it should be mandatory. shawnalpay flagged overlap with #966, which maintainers said on 27 May 2025 would be a prerequisite. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1103.title: [FR] Add a retention archival policy as a non-functional requirement
1103.author: Matt-Cowsert
1103.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 23 May 2025 for a non-functional requirement on retention and archival, arising from #1018. It asked generators to document how long they keep historical datasets, with 13 months suggested as a minimum. shawnalpay then asked whether the duty falls on generators or practitioners and how far back data should be available, saying more detail was needed. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1104.title: [FR] Clarify Capacity Reservation Scope & support for Used/Unused reporting
1104.author: ijurica
1104.summary: In May 2025 ijurica opened #1104 asking the working group to clarify the CapacityReservationId and CapacityReservationStatus requirements. The issue said used on-demand reservations are only recommended, not required, which makes used/unused splits unreliable. It also asked whether the columns cover Reserved Instances or only on-demand reservations, and whether the informal 0-cost Purchase Record workaround should be documented. The thread doesn't record the outcome, and the issue remains open.

1105.title: [FR] Add support for Data Center FOCUS dataset generation
1105.author: robmartin33
1105.summary: robmartin33 opened this request on 27 May 2025 asking for support for generating FOCUS datasets from data center cost sources, including site and rack location, asset contracts, linked assets, and depreciation. shawnalpay linked it to #965 and asked whether to combine the two. Matt-Cowsert chose to keep them separate. Matt-Cowsert later added King County, Disney and Atruvia as requesters. The thread doesn't record an outcome, and the issue remains open.

1106.title: [FR] Add export file paths and time period partitioning as a non-functional requirement
1106.author: Matt-Cowsert
1106.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 27 May 2025, asking whether FOCUS should require datasets to follow a normalized partition frequency, such as monthly, since some vendors do not partition monthly. It raised concerns about version changes falling mid-partition and about handling billing periods that span several months. The issue remains open, and the thread does not record any outcome.

1107.title: [FR] Add SaaS contract examples
1107.author: Matt-Cowsert
1107.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request in May 2025 for reference examples of spend-based SaaS contracts, covering yearly and monthly spend commitments, showing how they map to BilledCost, EffectiveCost, ContractedCost and PricingCategory. It also carries over cases from #1108, #1109 and #1110. Comments from daviddinhgcp suggested contract-type metadata and calculation guidance, and timwright2000 asked for explanation of flat-fee purchases and amortization. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue remains open.

1124.title: [FR] Add tag details for source attribution and eligibility
1124.author: Matt-Cowsert
1124.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request because practitioners could not tell which charges can be tagged or where a tag value came from. With kk09v and qquigley as sponsors and work starting in 1.4, TF-2 widened it from resource to charge tagging after cnharris10 noted SaaS tags without resources, and ruled out SKUs as the basis. From eleven candidate structures the group chose a key-driven TagDetails column alongside Tags, after kk09v's BigQuery tests, drafted as #1904. An AWS test showed data growing seven to eight times, tying it to column selection (#1091). In March 2026 shawnalpay opposed adding Recommended columns; maintainers found little support for #1904 as written, felt the scope had grown without re-review, and believed time had run out in the release.

1133.title: [FR] Add Commitment beneficiary attribution use case
1133.author: Matt-Cowsert
1133.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1133 on 10 June 2025, asking for a Use Case Library entry showing how to tell which account bought a shared commitment from the account that consumed its benefit, with SQL, to support chargeback. SAP requested it. Maintainers classed it as a practitioner enhancement related to #1134. The thread records no further discussion or outcome, and the issue remains open.

1134.title: [FR] Add guidance for provider credit attributes
1134.author: Matt-Cowsert
1134.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1134 on 10 June 2025, asking for guidance on provider credit attributes. FOCUS shows the result of credits but not their value, expiry, balance or eligible services. The maintainer assessment proposed non-normative appendix guidance first, with a later credit reference dataset. On 30 June 2025 Matt-Cowsert suggested it could be a supplementary dataset. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1192.title: [FR] Refine Billing and Charge Period definitions
1192.author: ljadvey
1192.summary: In July 2025, ljadvey asked for clearer definitions of the billing and charge period start and end columns, so the invoice window could be told apart from the usage window. shawnalpay asked whether a description change would suffice, and ljadvey confirmed it would be editorial only. On 22 July 2025, shawnalpay invited a pull request once the draft is ready. The thread records no outcome; the issue remains open.

1210.title: [FR] Add charge incurrence timestamp
1210.author: ijurica
1210.summary: In July 2025 ijurica proposed a charge incurrence timestamp, because ChargePeriodStart does not show when purchases were incurred. shawnalpay supported it and asked for examples. flanakin asked whether ChargePeriodStart already covers this. A January 2026 example showed no column gives incurrence time across categories. In February 2026 scope grew to add a data provision timestamp, moved to #2098 in March 2026. The thread records no decision; the issue remains open.

1249.title: [FR] Define logical column hierarchies in FOCUS
1249.author: Matt-Cowsert
1249.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested on 4 August 2025 a published, provider-agnostic semantic model defining drill-down hierarchies, such as Account, Service and Resource, across FOCUS columns. Maintainers called it a non-normative enhancement. On 11 August 2025 shawnalpay agreed semantic models matter but argued they are downstream supporting material that should rank behind spec-maturing work, suggesting community build one meanwhile. The thread doesn't record an outcome, and the issue remains open.

1366.title: [FR] Add support for FOCUS Data Connectors
1366.author: focus-automation
1366.summary: MGM requested standardized connectors for ingesting FOCUS data directly into analytics platforms, avoiding custom pipelines. Opened by focus-automation on 18 August 2025, the maintainer assessment in the description judged it a transport concern beyond the spec's scope and suggested non-normative delivery guidance as a minimal step. flanakin (8 September 2025) said it belongs outside the specification, and mike-finopsorg (9 September 2025) agreed. No outcome is recorded; the issue remains open.

1384.title: [FR] Add Amortized Cost to FOCUS
1384.author: Matt-Cowsert
1384.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1384 on 25 August 2025, proposing AmortizedCost and AmortizedUnitPrice as secondary columns beside EffectiveCost. On 7 September 2025, shawnalpay asked whether it replaced #961 and urged completion before the next maintainers meeting. On 8 September, Matt-Cowsert said it captured #961's essence with tighter scope, but earlier support was not carried over. The thread doesn't record the outcome, and the issue is still open.

1442.title: [FR] Add normative FOCUS schema document
1442.author: Matt-Cowsert
1442.summary: In September 2025 Matt-Cowsert requested a normative, machine-verifiable FOCUS schema so generators could validate output and consumers could automate checks. shawnalpay asked whether it should be built from existing files or from code, preferring existing files. ijurica asked whether it duplicated #1137. In March 2026 Matt-Cowsert merged #1137 and #1193 into this issue. It remains open, and the thread doesn't record a decision on the build approach.

1445.title: [FR] Correlate purchases with covered charges within one provider
1445.author: ijurica
1445.summary: ijurica opened #1445 in September 2025 to correlate single-provider purchases with covered charges. shawnalpay noted overlap with #978 and asked that categorization content be cut or scope widened. Maintainers judged it too large for one release, and Matt-Cowsert revised it. In July 2026 Matt-Cowsert proposed adding prepaid credits to scope, and kk09v agreed. In October 2026 triage requested revised organization and success criteria sections. It remains open.

1489.title: [FR] Add Line-Item Examples for Adjustment Scenarios
1489.author: Matt-Cowsert
1489.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request for line-item examples showing how discounts, credits, refunds, and corrections should appear in FOCUS data. They said practitioners face ambiguity about separate line items versus modifying existing charges, and about how ChargeCategory, ChargeClass, and cost columns relate. Maintainers assessed it as an adoption accelerator and outlined an MVP of five examples. The issue remains open; the thread doesn't record any further outcome.

1490.title: [FR] Add Pricing Unit Conversion Scenario Examples
1490.author: Matt-Cowsert
1490.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 29 September 2025 for a Pricing Unit Conversions section in the Supporting Content appendix. It would give worked examples, with step-by-step math, for cases where ConsumedUnit differs from PricingUnit, such as time-based usage priced by volume. Five organizations, including AWS, Google and Microsoft, requested it. The thread doesn't record a decision, and the issue was still open.

1491.title: [FR] Add Derived Charges Examples
1491.author: Matt-Cowsert
1491.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this feature request on 29 September 2025, asking for a Derived Charges section in the supporting content appendix. It would give examples of charges calculated from other charges, such as percentage-based support fees, quantity-based platform fees and quarterly true-up adjustments, and show how to link each to its basis. AWS, Neos, Amadeus, Google and Microsoft are listed as requesters. The thread records no outcome; the issue remains open.

1492.title: [FR] Add Cross-Provider Purchase-Usage Correlation for Marketplace Scenarios
1492.author: Matt-Cowsert
1492.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this feature request on 29 September 2025 seeking a standard identifier that links marketplace purchase records from cloud providers to SaaS usage records, so EffectiveCost and BilledCost can be reconciled across parties. Matt-Cowsert rated it high complexity and, the same day, recommended deferring it until single-provider correlation (#1445) is proven and a discovery phase is done. No other discussion is recorded, and the issue remains open.

1496.title: [FR] Add granularity level between sub account and resource
1496.author: Matt-Cowsert
1496.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested on 30 September 2025 a column for resource grouping between sub account and resource, split from #970. On 16 October 2025, participants agreed it may not apply to AWS. On 5 November 2025, shawnalpay reported pushback at the DC meeting, arguing it would not drive adoption. On 11 November 2025, Maintainers agreed to remove it from 1.4 scope. The issue remains open.

1502.title: [FR] Expand split cost allocation examples
1502.author: Matt-Cowsert
1502.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 6 October 2025 for a written FOCUS appendix example of provider-defined split cost allocation for Azure Cosmos DB. They said practitioners cannot tell when split allocation adds value beyond existing X_ columns or how RU-based ratios work, citing flanakin's review question and kk09v's verbal explanation. The proposed example uses 100 and 300 RU collections. The thread is still open and doesn't record an outcome.

1523.title: [FR] Allow ListCost to be null for charges without public list prices
1523.author: Matt-Cowsert
1523.summary: Matt-Cowsert asked in October 2025 to allow null ListCost for charges without public list prices, since FOCUS forces providers to report 0, which reads as free. shawnalpay noted the issue is bigger when only some products have public prices. kk09v, citing Irena's Maintainers suggestion, proposed reflecting contractual pricing instead when no list price exists. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it was still open.

1555.title: [FR] Clarify dataset scope in supported features
1555.author: shawnalpay
1555.summary: On 28 October 2025, shawnalpay opened #1555, asking that supported features name the FOCUS dataset they apply to, since existing features assumed one unnamed dataset. The proposed fix was to apply the term "Cost and Usage" across existing features, using the Contract Commitments feature as a template. A maintainer assessment in the body called it internal editorial work. The issue was still open, and the thread doesn't record a decision.

1573.title: [FR] Clarify cross-cloud mappings for the pricingCategory attribute
1573.author: PLeS207
1573.summary: PLeS207 opened #1573 on 2 November 2025, asking for non-normative mapping guidance that shows how AWS, Azure and GCP pricing fields correspond to the PricingCategory values, so cross-cloud filtering by pricing model gives consistent results. On 17 February 2026, Matt-Cowsert commented that this request will be merged into #1933, which concerns mapping multiple pricing opportunities, possibly through expanded category values. The thread remained open.

1625.title: [FR] Specify tier handling in requirements for List Unit Price and List Cost
1625.author: shawnalpay
1625.summary: shawnalpay asked that ListUnitPrice and ListCost requirements say which pricing tier they reflect, because AWS fills them from the highest tier, inflating savings. cnharris10 asked about negotiated tiers, which udam-stitcher said affect only contracted prices. udam-stitcher also noted a contradiction in the issue text and argued list price should follow the row's SKU Price ID, so existing rules may already cover tiers. It remained open, last discussed in November 2025.

1687.title: [FR] Update FOCUS Sandbox
1687.author: shawnalpay
1687.summary: In December 2025, shawnalpay requested an updated FOCUS Sandbox for FinOps X 2026, which held only 1.0 data. It proposed adding 1.2 datasets such as AWS and Databricks, with queries using current columns. In January 2026, follow-up actions were listed, including gathering 1.2 sample data and seeking updated AWS data from LF. In June 2026, the work moved to milestone v1.5. The issue remains open; no outcome is recorded.

1832.title: [FR] Clarify List Cost and List Unit Price defaulting when unit prices exclusive of discounts are not published
1832.author: ijurica
1832.summary: ijurica opened this issue on 14 January 2026, noting that Contracted Unit Price and Contracted Cost default to List values, but List Unit Price and List Cost have no default when a provider publishes no undiscounted prices. They asked whether to fix this in column definitions or normative requirements. On 23 January 2026, cnharris10 agreed it was a gap, citing Datadog's non-SKU minimum-spend contracts. The issue remains open.

1853.title: [FR] Add Resource Dataset
1853.author: Matt-Cowsert
1853.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 20 January 2026 for a normalized Resource dataset covering all charge-capable resources, including idle ones. It would let practitioners join inventory to cost data on ResourceId without custom integrations per provider. On 22 January 2026 shawnalpay asked that the resources in #1075 be considered and suggested dropping "Inventory" from the name. The thread doesn't record an outcome; it remains open.

1885.title: [AI] Add glossary link for "invoiced" in EffectiveCost and BilledCost definitions
1885.author: Matt-Cowsert
1885.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 24 January 2026 to link "invoiced" in BilledCost and EffectiveCost to a glossary entry. By April 2026 the working_draft glossary had invoice entries. Matt-Cowsert suggested linking to invoice, while shawnalpay suggested issued-invoice to show finalization. On 9 April 2026 members took the work out of consistency review scope, lacking agreement on the entry. shawnalpay noted a new "invoiced" entry would be needed. It remains open.

1890.title: [FR] Add normative requirement describing expected content to every column
1890.author: shawnalpay
1890.summary: Requester shawnalpay asked in January 2026 that every column have a normative requirement describing its expected content, since older columns like InvoiceIssuerName specify only type, presence and nulls. The request also covered free-form columns like RegionId and inconsistent allowed-value handling. In February 2026 maintainers agreed the work was needed but not yet in scope. In March 2026 Matt-Cowsert merged #1624 and #1078 into this issue, which remains open.

1932.title: [FR] Add Normalized Consumed Quantities
1932.author: Matt-Cowsert
1932.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #1932 requesting normalized consumed quantities to compare usage across SKUs billed hourly, daily or monthly. Two options were proposed: new normalized quantity and unit columns, or guidance with billing-cadence metadata. Matt-Cowsert noted it is separate from closed #1017 because it excludes percentile pricing and commitment discounts. In February 2026 shawnalpay suggested a required normalization factor in SkuPriceDetails, alongside or instead. No decision is recorded; the issue remains open.

1933.title: [FR] Revisit existing pricing categories to account for additional pricing dimensions
1933.author: Matt-Cowsert
1933.summary: On 30 January 2026, Matt-Cowsert asked for the PricingCategory value Committed to be revisited, because it requires a CommitmentDiscountId and leaves SaaS contractual commitments without a fitting category. The proposal adds a conditional PricingSubcategory column, splitting Committed into Commitment Discount and Contractual, with an alternative of relaxing the CommitmentDiscountId requirement. Datadog, MongoDB and Neos requested it. The thread is still open and records no discussion or decision.

1934.title: [FR] Add Charge Subcategory
1934.author: Matt-Cowsert
1934.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this feature request on 30 January 2026, proposing a ChargeSubcategory column to add finer detail under ChargeCategory, such as Unused Commitment, Allotment, Trial and Rounding. The request cites difficulty distinguishing promotional, allotment and trial credits, and carries over refund-related criteria from #971. Datadog, MongoDB, TechnologyOne and Software One are listed as requesters. The issue is still open and the excerpt holds no discussion or outcome.

1936.title: [FR] Invoice Detail Dataset Enhancements
1936.author: Matt-Cowsert
1936.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 31 January 2026 to cover capabilities deferred from the FOCUS 1.4 Invoice Detail dataset (#1500, #1900). They identified three gaps: payment lifecycle tracking (status and payment date), service and sub-account attributes held in JSON rather than columns, and an explicit FX rate. They targeted the 1.5 cycle and ranked payment lifecycle highest. The visible thread shows no discussion, and the issue remains open.

1937.title: [FR] Add FOCUS Metadata Dataset
1937.author: Matt-Cowsert
1937.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested on 31 January 2026 a formal FOCUS Metadata Dataset to fix inconsistent Metadata structure and undefined delivery timing and format. shawnalpay said it appears to duplicate #1854. In March 2026 shawnalpay noted marc-perreaut's suggestion to specify expected InvoiceDetailGrain schemas in Metadata, agreed in principle, but observed that similar columns like SkuPriceDetails lack such declarations, suggesting a holistic future approach. The thread is open and records no outcome.

1938.title: [FR] Contract Commitment Dataset Extension - Phase 2 (Placeholder)
1938.author: Matt-Cowsert
1938.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this placeholder request on 31 January 2026 to reserve space in the 1.5 queue for remaining Contract Commitment dataset columns, extending parent #1459 after PR #1924 covered ContractCommitmentScope for 1.4. The columns await design answers on open questions such as balance tracking, point-in-time versus versioning, and multiple commitment application. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

1943.title: [FR] Enhance AI and Machine Learning ServiceSubcategory to support layered AI cost analysis
1943.author: ljadvey
1943.summary: ljadvey proposed splitting the AI and Machine Learning subcategories into layers, including Agentic AI to replace Bots. shawnalpay questioned overlap with Compute and noted this is a service, not SKU, hierarchy, and ljadvey dropped the Infrastructure layer. In March 2026 Matt-Cowsert merged #1111 into this issue. In May 2026 the Task Force agreed it has room in 1.5, though its placement there still needed confirming. The issue remains open.

1962.title: 1.5 Release Scope / Themes / Milestones
1962.author: Matt-Cowsert
1962.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 5 February 2026 to set a living scope for FOCUS 1.5, cutting the target from about 100 story points to roughly 30 to match volunteer capacity. The scope has a committed Core, centered on the price sheet and AI work, and a community-driven Champion list. Matt-Cowsert updated the scope on 17 April 2026. The thread records no disputes or decisions, and it remains open.

1974.title: [FR] Ensure specification examples pass FOCUS Validator
1974.author: ljadvey
1974.summary: Issue #1974, opened by ljadvey on 7 February 2026, asked that the specification's worked CSV examples pass the FOCUS Validator, since many had missing columns and value errors. shawnalpay asked whether the work covered only version 1.2, and ljadvey proposed targeting the 1.3 validator, expected by the end of February 2026. Work moved to pull requests by izadoraluizalabs (#2558, #2661, #2662). In September 2026 #2661 and #2662 were postponed out of the 1.5 cycle, and qquigley took over #2558. On 23 September 2026 #2558 was postponed to the 1.6 cycle. In October 2026 finops-DaveMoreau was assigned to help, and Matt-Cowsert restated the scope as a full pass over published examples. In November 2026 #2558 stayed open for 1.6, along with #2661 and #2662. The issue remains open.

1976.title: [FR] Add Units of Measure Reference Dataset
1976.author: Matt-Cowsert
1976.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened issue #1976 on 9 February 2026 proposing a Units of Measure Reference Dataset that maps provider units to canonical forms, base units and conversion factors, and separates binary from decimal measures such as GB and GiB. The only comment, from mike-finopsorg the same day, asked whether FOCUS itself should define and publish the dataset instead of data generators. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue remains open.

1977.title: [FR] Add Resource Size Dataset
1977.author: Matt-Cowsert
1977.summary: Matt-Cowsert proposed a Resource Size dataset cataloguing all available sizes from a provider, including unused ones, to support rightsizing, normalization factors and what-if modeling. mike-finopsorg asked whether a Price List or SKU Details dataset could cover this instead of creating many narrow datasets. shawnalpay argued that Size is a separate grain and needed for recommendations. qquigley questioned whether it fits FOCUS. The issue remains open.

1980.title: [FR] Add National Currency Reference Dataset
1980.author: Matt-Cowsert
1980.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 10 February 2026 for a FOCUS reference dataset with currency names, symbols and decimal precision, plus exchange rates, so practitioners need not maintain their own. It also asked to separate national from virtual currencies. On 23 February 2026, shawnalpay said the request covers two datasets, a currency list and exchange rates, and asked for it to be split or renamed. It remains open.

1997.title: [FR] Add Payment Currency Support
1997.author: Matt-Cowsert
1997.summary: Matt-Cowsert requested in February 2026 a payment currency field, since invoices are often paid in another currency. The proposal was a PaymentCurrency dimension in the Cost and Usage dataset. shawnalpay replied that PR #1900 adds PaymentCurrency and PaymentCurrencyBilledCost to an Invoice Detail dataset, that an exchange rate column lacked support, and expected PR #1900 to merge in the 1.4 cycle, with later additions under #1936. The issue remains open.

2002.title: [FR] Revisit use of "FinOps practitioner" persona across the spec
2002.author: shawnalpay
2002.summary: shawnalpay opened this request on 17 February 2026 to revisit the phrase "FinOps practitioner", which appears about two dozen times in the spec. It follows a comment by mike-finopsorg on #1900, arguing that FOCUS data also serves finance and accounting users. Replacing the term with "FOCUS consumers" is suggested as one option. The thread records no discussion or decision, and the issue remains open.

2004.title: [FR] Drop Commitment from Contract Commitment dataset name
2004.author: ljadvey
2004.summary: ljadvey asked in February 2026 to drop Commitment from the Contract Commitment dataset and column names, because many contracts have no commitment. shawnalpay opposed the request in March 2026, saying the dataset was scoped in 1.3 development to commitments that yield a benefit, with commitment-free contracts represented by duplicating ContractId. ljadvey replied that the name restricts other contract types. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue remains open.

2036.title: [FR] Revisit ContractApplied.ContractCommitmentID Requirements to Align with CommitmentDiscount Handling
2036.author: ijurica
2036.summary: ijurica opened this feature request on 3 March 2026 asking that the ContractApplied.ContractCommitmentID rules be aligned with DiscountHandling. The existing rule required ContractCommitmentID to equal ResourceID for every Purchase row, while DiscountHandling limited that to purchases of the commitment itself. The proposal scoped the rule and added one for unused commitment usage rows. Neos requested it as nice to have. Maintainers labelled it a practitioner enhancement. The issue remains open.

2075.title: [FR] Add commitment eligibility to commitment discount examples
2075.author: Matt-Cowsert
2075.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 17 March 2026 to add CommitmentProgramEligibilityDetails to the commitment discount examples from #1877. None of the 14 datasets carries it, leaving Flexible Spend Plan, Dynamic Compute Commitment, partial and overage usage without eligibility. TechnologyOne raised the link at TF-2 on 11 March 2026. The body notes #1882 merged the column and FOCUS 1.4 published it. No outcome is recorded; the issue remains open.

2098.title: [FR] Add row-level data freshness timestamps
2098.author: Matt-Cowsert
2098.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this feature request on 21 March 2026, split from #1210, asking for row-level freshness timestamps so practitioners can see when an individual charge was last provided or updated, separate from dataset-level Recency Metadata. It proposed one or two date columns, citing Snowflake and Databricks patterns, and listed open design questions. The thread records no comments or decisions, and the outcome is not recorded; it remains open.

2102.title: [Feedback] Ambiguous nullability requirements in ContractedUnitPrice and ListUnitPrice
2102.author: thecloudman
2102.summary: thecloudman opened this issue on 24 March 2026, citing a conflict between nullability rules in ContractedUnitPrice and ListUnitPrice when a Usage or Purchase charge has a null SkuPriceId. Two fixes were proposed: a SkuPriceId qualifier, or removing the rule. shawnalpay shared an AI assessment leaning toward removal. ijurica noted an existing SkuPriceId requirement, so saw no true conflict. The thread doesn't record a decision and remains open.

2108.title: [AI] Consistently apply our non-standard subsections
2108.author: shawnalpay
2108.summary: Raised by shawnalpay on 25 March 2026, this issue flagged inconsistent subsection headers across FOCUS columns and asked for a shared context subheader. At the 17 April 2026 TF-3 call, Matt-Cowsert reported agreement on section order but not naming, and filed #2279 for ordering. shawnalpay believed partial progress came through #2309, #2310 and #2311. On 29 April 2026, Matt-Cowsert and ijurica confirmed naming work moves to 1.5. It remains open.

2119.title: [Feedback] Clarify consistency expectations for `CommitmentDiscountType` values
2119.author: ijurica
2119.summary: In March 2026, ijurica asked for explicit consistency expectations on CommitmentDiscountType, proposing a SHOULD requirement because display names need not be strictly immutable. The proposal also said values should match the provider's public terminology. shawnalpay replied that such blanket guidance would apply to many dimension columns and suggested an attribute instead. The thread doesn't record the outcome and remains open.

2174.title: [FR] Data Lineage Support - Distinguish data originators, processors, and intermediaries
2174.author: Matt-Cowsert
2174.summary: FR #2174 asks the spec to separate entities that originate FOCUS data from processors that transform it, so requirements say who they cover. At the 16 November 2026 Maintainers meeting, the group could not rate it as written and agreed to split the work: first a new FR defining the entities, then metadata rules, then lineage. Matt-Cowsert proposed the split, and it was agreed. A Maintainer doubts the problem statement and wants examples of 'data generator' meaning a processor, while others say many metadata rules fit anyone sharing a dataset. Overlap with #1226 is an open question. On 20 November rileyjenk argued the direct-to-seller marketplace case is an outlier, since major cloud marketplaces ban payments outside them. Views look mixed: agreement on sequencing, doubt on the problem. The FR as written has no decision; the new FR is next.

2294.title: [FR] Define Billing Period population relative to Cost and Usage
2294.author: Matt-Cowsert
2294.summary: Issue #2294, opened by Matt-Cowsert in April 2026, asks the specification to say which billing periods need a Billing Period row. The aim is to let practitioners join Billing Period metadata such as status and timestamps onto Cost and Usage without missing rows, and to give data generators a testable rule. The direction raised by shawnalpay is that every distinct billing period start and invoice issuer pair in Cost and Usage should have a matching Billing Period row. The only recent activity is a comment from rileyjenk on 20 November 2026, arguing that much of the use case is already covered by recency and that the feature could adapt that. rileyjenk thinks it is close but needs some work. No other replies appear, so the thread looks quiet and the next step is not defined.

2335.title: [FR] Revise Feature Levels to make FOCUS more globally applicable
2335.author: shawnalpay
2335.summary: shawnalpay asked to make Mandatory columns such as HostProviderName, ListCost and ContractedCost conditional so flat-fee SaaS and other non-cloud vendors could conform without inventing data. Earlier pull requests closed unmerged, and in 2026 the work narrowed to a contributor rubric for classifying new columns as Mandatory or Conditional (#2604), deferring existing columns to 1.6. In November 2026 the request, still open, went back to Seeking Champion for 1.6.

2371.title: [FR] Standardize AI provisioned throughput commitments
2371.author: Matt-Cowsert
2371.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 13 May 2026, carved out of #2018, to standardize how AI provisioned throughput commitments appear in FOCUS, covering token-based and capacity-based forms. The goal is consistent analysis without per-provider logic. A 14 May status update noted the separate filing and said next steps are working group review and the 1.5 candidate list. The thread doesn't record a final outcome, and the issue remains open.

2372.title: [FR] Define amortization methodology requirements for covering charges
2372.author: Matt-Cowsert
2372.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened #2372 on 13 May 2026, asking the spec to define normatively how covering charge cost is spread across covered charge rows, because providers differ and resource-level EffectiveCost fluctuates. On 31 May 2026 lionelvanbemten proposed amortizing by Contracted Cost rather than Pricing Quantity, asked how overlapping discounts are handled, and suggested using Contracted Cost for showback and chargeback. The thread doesn't record an outcome, and it remains open.

2393.title: [Feedback] CommitmentDiscountStatus-C-004-C rule definition is self-contradictory with C-003-C (validator-independent; 1.2 & 1.3)
2393.author: Matt-Cowsert
2393.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 18 May 2026, reporting that CommitmentDiscountStatus-C-004-C contradicts its sibling C-003-C. Both use the same condition, CommitmentDiscountId being null, yet demand opposite outcomes. The suggested fix mirrors CapacityReservationStatus-C-004-C, testing that the ID is not null and the charge category is Usage. The defect also appears in 1.3. It links #2394 and #142. The thread doesn't record an outcome; the issue remains open.

2394.title: [Feedback] FOCUS validator yields false-positive conditional-nullability failures — validator-vs-rule triage + rule-class audit
2394.author: Matt-Cowsert
2394.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 18 May 2026 after a compliant usage-only dataset failed FOCUS 1.2 nullability checks. Triage found a validator bug (#142), a mis-encoded rule (#2393) and one failure judged working as intended. The issue also sought an audit of similar rules. On 16 June 2026 Matt-Cowsert reported another inverted condition, in PricingCurrencyContractedUnitPrice-C-012-C, present in 1.3 and the 1.4 draft. The thread is still open.

2404.title: [Maintenance] RM 1.4: EntityName consistency, empty Requirement, and test-coverage cleanup
2404.author: Matt-Cowsert
2404.summary: On 21 May 2026, Matt-Cowsert opened #2404 after a review of #2049 found nine non-blocking consistency and test-coverage issues. They cover inconsistent EntityName labels, an empty Requirement on one rule, an orphaned applicability criterion, and loose checks in several test scripts. Matt-Cowsert flagged the issue for triage by shawnalpay and assigned mike-finopsorg as the likely implementer. The thread records no comments or decisions, and the issue remains open.

2409.title: [Feedback] Make currency scope explicit in SQL examples (document the single-currency assumption or group by BillingCurrency)
2409.author: Matt-Cowsert
2409.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 23 May 2026. Of 38 cost-aggregating SQL examples, 28 don't scope by currency, though they run correctly under an unstated single-currency assumption. Matt-Cowsert recommended documenting that assumption spec-wide, plus scoping comparison examples by BillingCurrency, and proposed it for 1.5. It is linked to #2407 and #1962. The thread records no discussion or decision, and the issue remains open.

2411.title: [FR] Augment correction handling examples and supported features
2411.author: ijurica
2411.summary: ijurica opened this request in May 2026 for correction handling examples covering Invoice Detail and Billing Period as well as Cost and Usage, plus auditability content with SQL for Replacement, Delta and Ledger corrections. On 5 October 2026 Matt-Cowsert asked for a priority for Neos, a split into two requests, and success criteria describing outcomes. Triage recorded these as revisions needed. The thread doesn't record a later outcome.

2414.title: [FR] Distinguish global from regional prices by region scope
2414.author: Matt-Cowsert
2414.summary: Matt-Cowsert proposed a FOCUS property distinguishing globally routed from region-pinned prices, mainly driven by AI model serving. The group debated its name and its link to the SKU Price dataset, with flanakin and ijurica raising naming and consistency concerns. On 23 September 2026 PR #2613 was postponed to the 1.6 cycle, and by 7 October 2026 no one had volunteered to take it up. The issue remains open.

2418.title: [Feedback] CommitmentDiscountStatus-C-005-M allowed values are Active/Expired/Pending but spec defines Used/Unused (all RM versions)
2418.author: Matt-Cowsert
2418.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 28 May 2026, saying the requirements model allows Active, Expired and Pending for CommitmentDiscountStatus, while the spec defines only Used and Unused. The defect appears in every model version. The suggested fix mirrors CapacityReservationStatus and coordinates with #2369. On 6 August 2026 mike-finopsorg asked Matt-Cowsert to confirm closure. The thread doesn't record the outcome; the issue is still open.

2437.title: [FR] Distinguish AI inference processing tiers
2437.author: Matt-Cowsert
2437.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 2 June 2026 to distinguish AI inference processing tiers, such as Standard, Priority and Batch, which are priced differently. At the 3 June 2026 Task Force 2 meeting it was kept separate from #2018, and its inclusion in 1.5 was left open. On 15 November 2026 thecloudman volunteered as champion and opened #2873, proposing a ProcessingTier property. The thread doesn't record the outcome.

2444.title: AI #2381: Add `Recommendation` dataset
2444.author: qquigley
2444.summary: qquigley proposed a Recommendation dataset, toward #975, to normalize optimization recommendations such as rightsizing and commitment purchases across providers and join them to Cost and Usage data. Matt-Cowsert asked what anchors a recommendation when ResourceId is null, and tfcross, flanakin, ijurica and kk09v requested further columns and statuses; the group widened the scope beyond cost. flanakin wanted the resource configuration columns folded into a JSON RecommendationDetails column, while rileyjenk wanted them kept. Task force 2 renamed Currency to RecommendationCurrency after shawnalpay asked for a prefix. Merges with working_draft dropped and then duplicated a section of data_model.md, and thecloudman found links that would break; these were fixed. shawnalpay named two threads as blocking in September 2026, and the pull request was still open after its October 2026 activity.

2447.title: [Feedback] 1.4 CostAndUsage requirements model: circular dependency between CommitmentDiscountQuantity and CommitmentDiscountUnit blocks the validator
2447.author: Matt-Cowsert
2447.summary: On 16 June 2026, Matt-Cowsert reported that the 1.4 CostAndUsage requirements model fails to load in the FOCUS validator because of a circular dependency between the CommitmentDiscountQuantity and CommitmentDiscountUnit rule families, though the build script still assembles it. Matt-Cowsert proposed breaking the mutual reference in the model or having the validator tolerate cycles, and suggested cycle detection in the build script. The thread doesn't record the outcome; it remains open.

2473.title: AI #2415: Add scoped detail configuration
2473.author: finops-DaveMoreau
2473.summary: finops-DaveMoreau proposed extending the Dataset Configuration attribute for #2415 so data generators could offer optional, higher-cardinality detail for documented parts of a dataset, which practitioners could select. ijurica argued the mapping from a chosen detail level to columns must be deterministic and raised aggregating records when high-cardinality columns are left out. The task force dropped the granularity framing for an opt-in documented by FOCUS dimensions, later renamed scoped detail, and ijurica explained split cost allocation as a narrower subset. Matt-Cowsert's reviews flagged undefined terms, which led to glossary entries, and how detail columns interact with column selection. ijurica's renames to detail variant and detail representation were adopted, qquigley kept Version Introduced at 1.4, and jpradocueva proposed restating requirements as checkable states. It remained open, last active in August 2026.

2487.title: [FR] Standardize billing representation for AI reasoning tokens
2487.author: davidearney
2487.summary: davidearney opened this request on 25 June 2026 seeking standard representation of AI reasoning tokens, which providers bill inconsistently. On 5 October 2026 Matt-Cowsert triaged it as revise success criteria, since two name specific models and others name a mechanism. Matt-Cowsert asked which providers bill reasoning tokens on a separate meter and noted PR #2606 does not separate reasoning from visible output. The request remains open.

2488.title: [FR] Standardize cost representation for AI context cache storage charges
2488.author: davidearney
2488.summary: davidearney opened this request on 25 June 2026 to standardize AI cache storage charges, proposing a K-Token-Hours unit and SkuMeter values. xyzs996 added pricing evidence in August 2026, arguing tiered prices change read and storage rates differently, so one meter cannot carry both. Matt-Cowsert replied in October 2026 that merged #2606 overlaps the request and asked for narrower scope, recording a triage outcome of needs scoping. It remains open.

2489.title: [FR] Add input modality classification and recommended SkuMeter values for multimodal AI inputs
2489.author: davidearney
2489.summary: davidearney proposed on 25 June 2026 SkuMeter values and an InputModality property for multimodal AI input charges. On 5 October 2026, Matt-Cowsert asked for the title, use case and success criteria to be revised, since they described the mechanism rather than the outcome. On 31 October, Matt-Cowsert confirmed the request could move to Under Consideration after those revisions. No revised version is recorded, and the issue remains open.

2512.title: [AI] Tighten Schemas-block DatasetId/DatasetName validation in the 1.5 requirements model
2512.author: Matt-Cowsert
2512.summary: On 2 July 2026, Matt-Cowsert opened this follow-up to #2471, which made DatasetId and DatasetName nullable in the 1.5 Schemas block. Unlike ModelRules, that block lacks a guard, though its Schema entities are dataset-scoped. #2471 was approved as non-blocking, deferring this tightening. It proposes reverting to non-null or documenting a rationale plus a guard. The thread shows no discussion; the issue remains open.

2515.title: [Feedback] DataGeneratorCalculatedSplitCostAllocationHandling: dimension-matching wording, missing double-counting rule, and undefined origin-row model
2515.author: thecloudman
2515.summary: On 6 July 2026 thecloudman opened this issue after reviewing #2395, flagging three existing gaps in the split cost allocation handling attribute: unclear "when present" dimension-matching wording, no double-counting rule, and no defined origin-row model. Matt-Cowsert replied on 30 July 2026 that the proposed wording fails for AllocatedMethodId and AllocatedMethodDetails, which may be non-null on origin charges, depending on #2578. The thread doesn't record the outcome and remains open.

2521.title: [FR] Distinguish AI model costs by context window size
2521.author: Matt-Cowsert
2521.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this enhancement request in July 2026 so FOCUS can separate charges for one AI model priced at a long-context rate from standard-rate charges. In November 2026, jerrysr99 reported 24 models across six providers priced by prompt size and took the work on. Task Force 1 later swapped PR #2871's numeric bounds for one String value. The thread does not record the outcome; it remains open.

2540.title: [AI] Add an IncludesAccountNaming condition for the BillingAccountName nullability requirement
2540.author: Matt-Cowsert
2540.summary: In July 2026 Matt-Cowsert opened #2540 proposing an IncludesAccountNaming condition. The billingaccountname.md nullability requirement is still prose, not a conditions anchor. Since #2472 moved rule CAU-BillingAccountName-C-003-C to an empty condition array, nothing links the rule to its gating state. The issue sets out a condition file, index inclusion, anchor change and model registration. No discussion or outcome is recorded; it remains open.

2541.title: [AI] Complete the Conditions migration follow-ups in Requirements Model 1.5
2541.author: Matt-Cowsert
2541.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 16 July 2026 to finish two follow-ups from the ApplicabilityCriteria-to-Conditions migration in #2472. Two SkuPriceId rules, C-014 and C-015, were gated on the broader IncludesUnitPricing condition instead of IncludesListUnitPrices and IncludesNegotiatedPricing, and the test suite did not catch it. The contributor guide also still used pre-1.5 flag names. No comments or outcome are recorded, and the issue remains open.

2572.title: [AI] Update the editorial guidelines for section heading naming and supported column coverage
2572.author: Matt-Cowsert
2572.summary: In July 2026 Matt-Cowsert opened this to record two unwritten editorial conventions from #2493: whether headings use display names or ColumnIds, and that each supporting column on a supported features page appears in a query there. ijurica recommended display names; jpradocueva raised the same point. TF2 agreed to write the guideline first. On 27 October 2026 Matt-Cowsert moved it to 1.6 under #2778, and ijurica agreed. It remains open.

2583.title: AI #2575: Add Recommendation supported feature, examples, and sample data (FR 975)
2583.author: qquigley
2583.summary: qquigley opened this PR on 31 July 2026 to add practitioner documentation for the FOCUS 1.5 Recommendation dataset defined in #2444: a supported feature page, a worked example, and a nine-row sample dataset. Matt-Cowsert retargeted its base branch in August 2026 to remove an inflated diff. Reviewers then flagged query problems: a spend join that dropped a commitment purchase, which qquigley fixed with a left join, plus null sort order, dead dataset links and quoting. flanakin, Matt-Cowsert and jpradocueva approved between 11 and 29 September 2026. shawnalpay requested changes on 27 September 2026, arguing that before, after and delta spend belong natively in the Recommendation dataset. ijurica's currency and region comments from 1 October 2026 remain open. The thread doesn't record a merge, so the PR remains open.

2598.title: [Feedback] For FOCUS 1.3, seven rules have inconsistent description versus implementation
2598.author: AndrewYinLi
2598.summary: On 3 August 2026, AndrewYinLi opened #2598 reporting that seven rules in the FOCUS 1.3 model file contradicted their implementations, causing false positives and negatives in conformance checks. Problems included non-standard AND shapes, flipped null checks, and a wrong gate column key. Each rule came with a proposed fix. The thread recorded no replies, and the issue was still open. The thread doesn't record the outcome.

2604.title: FR #2335: Add the feature-level rubric for Mandatory and Conditional
2604.author: Matt-Cowsert
2604.summary: In August 2026, Matt-Cowsert opened this pull request to carry ijurica's restructured feature-level rubric, replacing #2596 after its branch name blocked local work. jpradocueva's reviews raised findings on contradictory branching, code-fence formatting, a miscounted revision history, stale principle references and missing glossary links. Matt-Cowsert applied most fixes, including removing the variance gate's path to Conditional. qquigley asked for italics on operating model terms. flanakin flagged a missing build step for new Conditions, and Matt-Cowsert addressed it on 10 September 2026. In September, shawnalpay requested changes, calling it too verbose and suggesting it wait for a later release. Several reviews were later dismissed. Whether eight variance-gated columns should move from Conditional to Mandatory was left for the Task Force. The thread records no final outcome; the pull request remained open.

2613.title: FR #2414: Region scope as a SkuPriceDetails property
2613.author: Matt-Cowsert
2613.summary:
Matt-Cowsert opened #2613 on 10 August 2026 to implement FR #2414 by adding a FOCUS-defined region scope property to SkuPriceDetails, with example values "Global", "Regional" and "DataZone", a footnote separating it from RegionId and Redundancy, and an appendix example. It was drafted as ServingScope.

Reviewers questioned the name: flanakin and marc-perreaut found "serving" unclear, and udam-stitcher and mike-finopsorg backed GeographicScope. ijurica wanted pricing framing dropped, and qquigley objected to an undefined population rule. Matt-Cowsert amended the footnote and argued PricingRegionId cannot close the gap. After flanakin's research (#2672), RegionScope was settled on 17 September, and #2667 merged into the branch on 23 September. jpradocueva's validation passed. On 18 November, jerrysr99 asked whether SKU versus SKU Price placement should be decided once. The PR remains open.

2635.title: [AI] Add a build check comparing JSON object property keys to the requirements model
2635.author: Matt-Cowsert
2635.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 12 August 2026 proposing an automated build check that compares JSON object property keys with the requirements model, to prevent a repeat of the ContractApplied key casing error fixed in 1.4. It was rescoped from a checklist item, since erratum #3 already records that correction. A sweep found no current casing drift in eight JSON columns. The thread doesn't record the outcome.

2641.title: [AI] Reconcile bundled discount example with revised list and contracted unit price definitions
2641.author: Matt-Cowsert
2641.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this issue on 14 August 2026 because the bundled discount footnote and example in the discount handling supporting content appear to conflict with the revised List Unit Price definition in #2567. A bundled discount is neither negotiated nor commitment-conditional, so its place across the unit price and cost columns is unclear. aaronmsoto raised it on #1835. The thread records no comments or decision, and the issue remains open.

2642.title: [FR] Define a discount taxonomy
2642.author: Matt-Cowsert
2642.summary: Matt-Cowsert opened this request on 14 August 2026 for a single reference categorizing FOCUS discount constructs and their position in the cost and unit price columns. On 5 October 2026 Matt-Cowsert split off the discount-identification question into #2741 and asked listed organizations to confirm support and priority. The triage outcome, recorded in a comment, was to revise the requesting organizations. The issue remains open.

2645.title: Adding in examples of custom columns on sku price dataset
2645.author: rileyjenk
2645.summary: rileyjenk proposed example custom columns, with CSV data, for the SKU Price dataset appendix as part of #2807. Matt-Cowsert requested changes because the branch had fallen behind and its rate card edits would undo later fixes, beau-finopsorg flagged conflicts and an unedited description, and flanakin asked whether the columns duplicated existing SkuPriceDetails properties. It remained open as of September 2026, with conflicts and a change request outstanding.

2654.title: [FR] Companion Utilization dataset for usage-vs-cost decomposition
2654.author: thecloudman
2654.summary: thecloudman opened #2654 on 24 August 2026, proposing an optional Utilization dataset joinable to Cost and Usage on ResourceId and charge period, splitting capacity into used, idle and never-requested. Riley Jenkins and Shawn Alpay questioned whether FOCUS should define this or defer to OpenTelemetry. #1050 and #1022 were merged in. On 5 October 2026, Matt-Cowsert applied triage labels needing success criteria, organization priorities and scoping. It remains open.

2657.title: [AI] AGENTS.md rules that diverge from established spec-wide practice
2657.author: jpradocueva
2657.summary: Issue #2657, opened by jpradocueva on 26 August 2026, gathered validation findings where AGENTS.md writing rules conflicted with long-established specification practice, covering notes formatting, linking, and conditional phrasing. The choice was to amend the rules or sweep the spec into line. Follow-up comments added evidence through September 2026, and an October 2026 draft proposed repairs to seven editorial rules. At Task Force 1 on 20 October 2026, a proposal to move most of the item to the 1.6 cycle was made, and Matt-Cowsert agreed. Display-name versus ColumnId references and first-mention linking stay in the 1.5 consistency review under #2772, through pull request #2773. The thread records no final closure.

2661.title: FR #1974: Update SaaS examples to the FOCUS 1.3 schema
2661.author: izadoraluizalabs
2661.summary: On 29 August 2026, izadoraluizalabs opened #2661 to update the SaaS example datasets toward FOCUS 1.3, related to #1974. The changes add required columns, normalize numeric values and identifiers, and fill in currency, provider, publisher, SKU meter and classification values. Validation ran without forcing all applicability criteria, and some failures were left for Task Force review. The thread has no other discussion; the pull request is still open.

2662.title: FR #1974: Update commitment discount examples to the FOCUS 1.3 schema
2662.author: izadoraluizalabs
2662.summary: In August 2026, izadoraluizalabs opened #2662 to move commitment discount examples to the FOCUS 1.3 schema, related to #1974. It adds required columns, normalizes numeric values and reorders the data.
